description: Vehicle trajectory data in Eco-friendly Cooperative Traffic Optimization (EcoTOp) system at signalized intersections is a data set deposited in Dryad by its authors Peng Hao, David Oswald (University of California, Riverside). Surface transportation systems (e.g., arterial roadways with signalized intersections) are inherently inefficient, particularly at higher traffic volumes. In general, both the infrastructure (e.g., traffic signals) and the vehicles operate independently, with little coordination between them. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 213499213 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-dryad-repository.
